'''HK-01's Droid Army''' was a [[Militia/Legends|militia]] formed by rogue [[HK-series assassin droid]] [[HK-01]] to [[Droid supremacy|oppose]] organic [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life.

HK-01 and his [[Army/Legends|army]] started the [[Great Droid Revolution]] in [[4015 BBY]], fighting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and its "superior" organic citizenry. HK and the army met their end when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] used a [[Ionize|new Force power]] to stop their violent tirade.
